From a folder or unified inbox view, tap the ||| in the top left If you don't see the accounts on the far left, tap Show Accounts When the accounts show, tap the gear lower left

You are now in settings. You'll see a section for Accounts. At the bottom, "Add account". Tap and proceed to add your next account.
